mutations.name: native maxTurns maps back to the ambiguous runtime_error
mutations.find: case "max_turns": return { kind: "limit_exceeded", reason: `native maxTurns reached: ${reason}`, unit: "agent_iterations" };
mutations.replace: case "max_turns": return { kind: "runtime_error", reason: `native maxTurns reached: ${reason}` };
kills: durable harness dispatch persists a Claude run that reached its native maxTurns as a terminal failure
